gloss: With unified will, we can build a strong fortress.
teaser: Today, we explore the power of collective determination.
script: Welcome to Chengyu Bites — your quick summary on Chinese 成语. Today, we explore the power of collective determination.[break 1s] The phrase is: 众志成城 (zhòng zhì chéng chéng).[break 0.5s] 众 (zhòng) means 'crowd' or 'many'.[break 0.5s] 志 (zhì) means 'will' or 'aspiration'.[break 0.5s] 成 (chéng) means 'to become' or 'to build'.[break 0.5s] 城 (chéng) means 'city' or 'fortress'.[break 1s] Together, it means:众志成城 literally translates to 'many wills become a fortress', figuratively signifying that united efforts can overcome any obstacle.[break 1s] Here’s the story behind it:[break 1.5s] This idiom originates from a historical context during the Warring States period in China, where various states fought for control. It was noted that when people unite with a common goal, they can form a strong defense, much like building a city out of their collective will. This concept became a powerful symbol for cooperation and solidarity among people.[break 1.5s] Example 1: 大家齐心协力，众志成城，必定能战胜困难。 [break 1s] Everyone working together, united in will, can surely overcome difficulties. [break 1s] Example 2: 在这个项目中，众志成城的精神激励着每一个人。 [break 1s] The spirit of unity inspires everyone in this project. [break 1s] Example 3: 面对挑战，我们要众志成城，共同努力。 [break 1s] Facing challenges, we must unite and work hard together. [break 1s] So, remember, 众志成城 means with unified will, we can build a strong fortress. Thank you for listening to Chengyu Bites! See you next time for another idiom.[break 1s]
